name: Your Lists cards match the shared card
summary: Reported by John: the Trouble/Favourites cards put the level at the bottom and a remove X in the top-right corner every other page gives the level. Render them through the shared explorer card and rehome the remove action.

summary: Lists becomes top level and Libraries moves into a new Settings page, which also gives the display name and WaniKani connection a home. Explore, Progress and Read absorb the paired items, taking the header from ten items to eight.

name: Release names show kana and kanji
summary: The release name prints its kana reading beside the kanji instead of hiding the kanji in a tooltip, so both scripts are readable at a glance.
